name: br-faker
description: Brazilian fake data: a shared generator core, an Alfred workflow and a browser extension that fills forms
author: Adriano Gonçalves

scripts.art: npm run icon && npm run banner
scripts.workflow: npm run build -w @br-faker/alfred && npm run icon && node packages/alfred/scripts/build-workflow.mjs
scripts.extension: npm run icon && npm run build -w @br-faker/extension
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
